settings.description: About the courses, the book and the letter.

settings.text: If yours is not here, write to me.

settings.question: Do I need to be able to draw already?
settings.answer: No. Sketchbook Basics starts with lines and boxes, and most people who take it have not drawn since school.

settings.question: What do I need to start?
settings.answer: Any pen and any paper. Each lesson lists what I use, and none of it is required.

settings.question: How long do I keep the course?
settings.answer: For as long as the course exists. Watch the lessons at your own pace and come back to them.

settings.question: Can I cancel The Drawing Table?
settings.answer: Yes, any time from your account. You keep access until the end of the month you paid for.

settings.question: Is the book a PDF or a paper book?
settings.answer: Both are listed. The paper book ships in a few days, the PDF arrives straight away.

settings.question: Is Sunday Sketch really free?
settings.answer: Yes. Sometimes it mentions the book or a course, and you can leave with one click.
